episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Aristocrat-turned-pirate-captain Stede Bonnet is put to the test when his crew encounters a British naval vessel.

episodes.title: A Damned Man
episodes.summary: Stede battles feelings of guilt while hunting for missing hostages. Lucius makes a surprising discovery

episodes.title: A Gentleman Pirate
episodes.summary: Stede (a.k.a. "The Gentleman Pirate") conducts business in the Republic of Pirates. Oluwande and Jim face their past.

episodes.title: Discomfort In a Married State
episodes.summary: As the threat of attack looms, Blackbeard and Stede finally meet. Jim fields questions from an overly curious crew.

episodes.title: The Best Revenge Is Dressing Well
episodes.summary: Blackbeard and Stede attend a fancy party. Oluwande and Frenchie embrace false identities. Izzy and Lucius go head-to-head.

episodes.title: The Art of F**kery
episodes.summary: Stede and crew stage a spectacle. Blackbeard struggles to carry out his plan.

episodes.title: This Is Happening
episodes.summary: A trip to St. Augustine reveals more about Jim's past. Stede leads Blackbeard on an adventure.

episodes.title: We Gull Way Back
episodes.summary: The arrival of Blackbeard's old buddy leaves Stede feeling like the odd man out. As Oluwande mourns a loss, Jim seeks answers from Spanish Jackie.

episodes.title: Act of Grace
episodes.summary: Captured and facing trial, Stede and Blackbeard face tough choices and an uncertain future.

episodes.title: Wherever You Go, There You Are
episodes.summary: While Stede attempts to reenter his old life, Blackbeard tends to a wounded heart.

episodes.title: Impossible Birds
episodes.summary: While Stede adjusts to his new normal, a heartbroken Blackbeard fills the void with daily raids – sparking concern amongst Izzy and the crew.

episodes.title: Red Flags
episodes.summary: Aboard Zheng's ship, Stede, Olu and Black Pete have surprising revelations while Blackbeard's crew plots their revenge.

episodes.title: The Innkeeper
episodes.summary: When Zheng unexpectedly takes hold of the Revenge, the reunited crew starts to plan their escape. Meanwhile, a preoccupied Stede resorts to desperate measures to bring back Blackbeard, who must confront a life-or-death decision of his own.

episodes.title: Fun and Games
episodes.summary: After he's banished from the Revenge, Blackbeard unwittingly receives relationship advice from some dysfunctional old friends.

episodes.title: The Curse of the Seafaring Life
episodes.summary: As Blackbeard remains plagued by the distrust of his crew, Izzy schools Stede on how to be an effective captain.

episodes.title: Calypso's Birthday
episodes.summary: While the crew celebrates Calypso's birthday, Blackbeard faces a violent party-crasher seeking revenge.

episodes.title: Man on Fire
episodes.summary: As Blackbeard reevaluates his life, Stede revels in his newfound infamy. With some help from Jim, Oluwande reunites with a hesitant Zheng.

episodes.title: Mermen
episodes.summary: Stede, Zheng, Spanish Jackie, and the rest of the Revenge crew team up to take down a nefarious common enemy threatening the world of piracy.
